story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: From a hello to a forever
intro: It all began with a simple hello, under a tree where students parked their scooters.
Here, year after year, is the path that led us here.

items.title: Law school
items.subtitle: Just classmates
description: A hello, a smile exchanged under the tree where students parked their scooters. Moments that seemed insignificant, but that would mark the beginning of everything.
It was through a mutual friend that we really started talking. A beautiful friendship was born; conversations, regular catch-ups, a closeness that quietly grew.
Geovanni shared his old exam papers to help Stella prepare for her exams. We were simply friends. Or so we thought.

items.title: France
items.subtitle: Miles apart
description: Our paths separated. Geovanni left for France. Despite the distance and our new lives, we kept in touch as good friends.

items.title: Tunisia, then France
items.subtitle: Never really far apart
description: Stella then left for Tunisia. Then, toward the end of the year, something changed: a little flirting here, a few extra attentions there... and, almost without realizing it, our beautiful friendship turned into a love story.
In December 2019, we officially became a couple. A new adventure began: a long-distance love, with miles between us, but a growing desire to stay close.

items.title: What if it was all written?
items.subtitle: Together on the same soil
description: Fate, after keeping us apart, finally decided to bring us together: Stella, too, moved to France.

That's when Stella discovered a rather funny little secret: Geovanni had always had a soft spot for her, long before she suspected it. Screenshots of her status updates, carefully saved. Conversations with our mutual friend, accompanied by a mysterious “Mrs. Etekpor”...
The funniest part? At the time, we were still just friends. Proof that sometimes the heart knows what we don't yet.

items.title: Forever
items.subtitle: Our most beautiful chapter
description: Years have passed since that first hello under the tree. What started as a simple encounter, then a beautiful friendship, has become a solid, deep, and precious love.
Today, after all these years, we have chosen to seal this love and write together the most beautiful chapter of our story: that of our union.

closing: And if our story began with a simple “hello,”
today we're lucky enough to be able to give it

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: A question before the big day?
contact.copy: So that the couple can fully enjoy their day with complete peace of mind, we are here to answer all your questions and support you. Should you have any concerns at all, please contact us directly by phone or WhatsApp.

items.question: Do we need two different outfits for the ceremony and the reception?
items.answer: No, it is not mandatory. Some colors work for both the ceremony and the reception: #D8D0C2, #DCC9A6 and #914F3C.

items.question: If we don't have Revolut, can we give a material gift?
items.answer: The payment link is accessible even if you don't have Revolut. If you run into any issues, please contact one of the two wedding planners. The couple does not wish to receive material gifts.

items.question: Do we get discounts at the listed hotels?
items.answer: Unfortunately not. This list is provided for information only, to save you some research. You are free to choose other hotels or Airbnb options.

items.question: Are there any specific arrangements for children?
items.answer: The reception venue has a room dedicated to children. However, each parent is responsible for their own child, and no childcare service will be provided.

items.question: During the break from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM, can we wait at the reception venue?
items.answer: The reception venue will be in the midst of preparations for the evening and unfortunately won't be able to welcome you before 4:00 PM. We invite you to make the most of this break to rest at your accommodation or explore the city.

items.question: Can I bring a plus-one?
items.answer: Invitations are individual and personal. If your partner has not received the site access link and password, this unfortunately means they have not been invited. If you are a couple or a family and each of you has received the link and password, please register individually, including children aged 2 and over.

legal.notice: This private website is intended only for guests of Stella and Geovanni's wedding. It centralizes practical information and RSVP responses related to the event.
legal.privacy: Data submitted through the RSVP form is used only to organize the wedding: name, email, phone number, attendance, menu choice and dietary restrictions. It is not sold or shared with third parties outside event organization needs.
